scope: Purified ORP8 protein (0.5 μg) in kinase assay buffer (60 mM Tris, 10 mM MgCl2, 0.1 mM Na3VO4, 5 mM β-Glycerophosphate, 5 mM DTT and 100 μM AMP) was incubated with kinase-active AMPK complex (0.2 μg)
The band of ORP8 was cut down and performed in-gel digestion with trypsin at 37oC overnight.
Phosphorylated ORP8 from in vitro kinase assay was analyzed by mass spectrometry.
